title: [epic] wolfssl asymmetric crypto providers for /dev/crypto2dev
description:
Implement RSA, ECDH, and ECDSA providers in crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko so userspace can do asymmetric crypto via /dev/crypto2dev ioctls.

## Why this exists
The chardev framework has DO_SIGN, DO_VERIFY, DO_AGREE ioctls fully wired. The provider vtable has sign/verify/agree/key_import/key_free fields. But every provider sets those to NULL today. libwolfssl.ko exports all the required wc_* symbols. The gap is three C source files.

## Scope
Three new files in src/providers/wolfssl/:
  wolfssl_rsa.c   — RSA-2048/4096 key import, sign (PKCS#1 v1.5), verify, generate, export
  wolfssl_ecdh.c  — EC P-256/P-384 key import, ECDH+HKDF agree, generate, export
  wolfssl_ecdsa.c — EC P-256/P-384 key import, ECDSA sign, verify

## API ground truth (verified from ~/wolfssl/linuxkm/libwolfssl.ko nm output)
All required symbols are exported by libwolfssl.ko:
  RSA:   wc_InitRsaKey_ex, wc_FreeRsaKey, wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode, wc_RsaPublicKeyDecode,
         wc_RsaSSL_Sign, wc_RsaSSL_Verify, wc_RsaPublicEncrypt, wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt,
         wc_RsaEncryptSize, wc_RsaSetRNG, wc_MakeRsaKey, wc_RsaKeyToDer, wc_RsaKeyToPublicDer
  ECC:   wc_ecc_init_ex, wc_ecc_free, wc_ecc_make_key_ex, wc_ecc_shared_secret,
         wc_ecc_sign_hash, wc_ecc_verify_hash, wc_ecc_import_x963_ex,
         wc_EccPrivateKeyDecode (asn_public.h), wc_EccPublicKeyDecode,
         wc_ecc_export_x963, wc_ecc_export_private_only, wc_ecc_sig_size, wc_ecc_set_rng
  KDF:   wc_HKDF_Extract, wc_HKDF_Expand (needed by ECDH agree for in-device HKDF)
  ASN:   wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset (to skip PKCS#8 wrapper before RSA/ECC decode)

## Key format contract (UAPI: write-before-ioctl pattern)
  RSA private: PKCS#8 unencrypted DER (wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset + wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode)
  RSA public:  SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER (wc_RsaPublicKeyDecode — handles SPKI directly)
  EC private:  PKCS#8 unencrypted DER (wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset + wc_EccPrivateKeyDecode)
  EC public:   SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER (wc_EccPublicKeyDecode) OR raw 04||x||y (wc_ecc_import_x963)

## Provider callback signatures (from crypto2dev_provider.h)
  sign:  int (*sign)(void *key_ctx, const char *hash_algo, const u8 *digest, u32 digest_len, u8 *sig, u32 sig_bufsz, u32 *sig_len)
  verify: int (*verify)(void *key_ctx, const char *hash_algo, const u8 *digest, u32 digest_len, const u8 *sig, u32 sig_len)
  agree: int (*agree)(void *key_ctx, const u8 *peer_pubkey, u32 peer_pubkey_len, const u8 *salt, u32 salt_len, const u8 *info, u32 info_len, u8 *okm, u32 okm_len)
  key_import: int (*key_import)(void **key_ctx, u32 key_type, const u8 *raw, u32 rawlen)
  key_free:   void (*key_free)(void *key_ctx)

## Critical invariants (FIPS 140-3)
  - FIPS gate is first line of every callback (wolfssl_fips_gate())
  - PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA sign: provider must construct DigestInfo DER (OID+digest) before wc_RsaSSL_Sign; input is pre-hashed
  - ECDH agree: zero shared secret Z with memzero_explicit before returning — Z must never leave provider
  - All key_free: memzero_explicit(key_ctx) before kfree
  - wc_* error codes: check != 0 (not < 0); translate to kernel errno via xlat_err helper
  - Min RSA key: 2048 bits (FIPS 140-3); min EC curve: P-256 (FIPS 140-3 approved)
notes:
WOLFCRYPT_DIR for local builds: ~/wolfssl (has pre-built libwolfssl.ko and Module.symvers).
Module name is libwolfssl.ko (not wolfcrypt.ko — CLAUDE.md is wrong on this).
All wc_* symbols verified present via: nm ~/wolfssl/linuxkm/libwolfssl.ko | grep ' T wc_'
Headers: ~/wolfssl/wolfssl/wolfcrypt/rsa.h, ecc.h, asn_public.h, kdf.h, random.h
The wolfssl_ec_key.h shared helper pattern: static inline functions in a header included by both wolfssl_ecdh.c and wolfssl_ecdsa.c. No separate .o file. Functions: wolfssl_ec_key_import(), wolfssl_ec_key_free(), wolfssl_ec_key_generate(), wolfssl_ec_key_export_public(), wolfssl_ec_key_export_private().
